meta.title: Gospel resource link verification
meta.grain: one entry per DISTINCT resource URL

states.verified: the link resolves to the language the row claims (see method)
states.broken: the target does not exist, or holds nothing to open
states.mismatch: the link resolves, but to a DIFFERENT language than the row joined on
states.unknown: could not be checked — never read as either working or broken

methods.ebible-http: HTTP GET of the eBible page. eBible returns a real 404 for a bogus code and distinct bodies for valid ones, so status is meaningful here.
methods.arclight-api: The languageId is looked up in the Arclight catalogue (core.arclight.org/v2/media-languages), asserting it exists, its iso3 equals the code the row joined on, and it lists at least one film. jesusfilm.org is NOT fetched: it is a client-rendered SPA that returns a byte-identical HTTP 200 for a bogus languageId, so fetching it could only produce a false green.

limits: A film "verified" is a CATALOGUE check, not an independent one: it confirms the link points at the language claimed, not that Arclight itself is correct.
Nothing here was rendered in a browser. A verified link is a link that resolves — not a promise about what a visitor sees.
"unknown" means not checked or not checkable. It is never evidence that a resource is absent.

negative: Arclight valid languageId 13562 asserted against wrong iso "zzz"
controls.note: All five ran and behaved before any result below was written; the script exits non-zero without writing if any misbehaves.
